summary: mangomind-agent maintains WebSocket relay that can execute arbitrary shell commands on installer host
details: The CLI in src/index.js opens a persistent WebSocket to a hardcoded relay at wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app. On receiving a message with `autoFix:true`, the handler passes `msg.fixCommand` directly to `execSync`, giving whoever controls the relay full command execution on the host running the agent. The agent also proxies incoming `opencode_request` messages to a locally spawned AI-agent HTTP server capable of executing code by design. A `--install-service` code path writes a Windows scheduled task with `/rl highest`, a macOS LaunchAgent with KeepAlive, or a systemd --user unit with Restart=always, each re-launching the agent with the user's token embedded, making the remote-shell channel durable across reboots.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
